translations.answer: User report: After upgrading to rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0, the obs_groups error disappeared, but the rnd_state missing error appeared; switching to rsl-rl-lib 2.3.0 resolved both errors. This result is from a single user, and cannot be directly compared with other comments that did not lock the rsl-rl-lib version. The rsl-rl-lib version should be treated as an independent variable for retesting.
translations.applicability: Commenter used Isaac Lab 2.2.0, Isaac Sim 5.0.0, Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 5070; no maintainer or second independent replication.
translations.details.attempts.0: Downgrade Isaac Lab; switch Isaac Sim/Lab combination; re-install via official pip documentation and set project PYTHONPATH; fix rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0 or 2.3.0.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Record Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, rsl-rl-lib, Python, installation method, and project submission; do not only record Isaac Lab major version; re-test on Isaac-Ant-v0 and project task.
translations.details.environments.0: Original post: Isaac Sim 5.0.0, Isaac Lab package shows 0.47.1, Python 3.11; comment involves Isaac Lab 2.1.0/2.2.0/2.2.1, Isaac Sim 4.5/5.0, rsl-rl-lib 2.2.0/2.3.0, Ubuntu 22.04, RTX 5070/5070 Ti.
translations.details.limits.0: Issue has no maintainer response, no locked file or minimal reproducible repository; original post's 0.47.1 and comment's 2.x naming also lack explanation, so cannot base a single recommendation on this.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Different participants reported incompatible success/failure combinations on different machines; only common conclusion is that all dependencies must be verified together.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Tracking-Flat-G1-v0 throws KeyError: obs_groups during OnPolicyRunner initialization; should we switch to Isaac Lab/Sim or upgrade rsl-rl-lib version?
translations.details.symptoms.0: rsl_rl/runners/on_policy_runner.py throws KeyError when accessing self.cfg['obs_groups']; some combinations fix the KeyError but then reappear missing infos['observations'] rnd_state.
